purpose: Machine-readable final commands for L1 to run once after the round-14 artifacts are committed. This plan was written by code inspection only; its author executed none of the commands, no build, no test, no linter, no formatter and no smoke run.
scope: Round-14 C1 digest-bound evidence-cache eligibility and C2 census credential-boundary refusal, plus the retained legacy census selftest, ShellCheck warning gate and the corpus/SOURCES.md census. This is not comprehensive recertification and it grants no deletion authority.

axes.name: calibration
axes.claim: Every C1 eligibility claim is tied to the installed bytes and to named finding ids derived from the landed code, not from prose. A stale or legacy retained green is never reused; each record keeps its own measured_commit.
nonclaims: A reusable verdict is digest eligibility over the declared dependencies only.
It is not proof that the recorded command executed, or that it executed at the declared revision.
It does not cover undeclared or transitive dependencies.

axes.name: operability
axes.claim: The census refuses a root or compare path that overlaps the credential-store boundary before any git/find/du/content access, and the legacy census interface still works.
nonclaims: The boundary fixture covers only the enumerated synthetic cases.
It is not a universal filesystem-alias proof and does not certify the census.
It never reads the real credential store.

baseline.why: Last committed round-13 spot-check revision; the C2 baseline census blob and the SOURCES.md before-count are read from this commit.
baseline.census_sha256_source: sha256sum of both the working tree file and the a31642d blob at plan-writing time; the two were equal
baseline.note: The working tree is expected to differ from this baseline after the round-14 commit. baseline.commit names the blob used for the red arm; measured_commit must name the commit that contains the bytes actually measured.

environment.synthetic_home: The suite exports HOME=<scratch>/home, created under the same /var/tmp scratch root. No command in this plan may inherit or read the operator HOME.
environment.versions_note: These are host observations, not installs. shellcheck is re-checked by C-R14V-06; an absent shellcheck is could-not-evaluate, never a pass.

outcome_taxonomy.pass: The command ran to completion, exited with the declared pass exit, and every declared stdout literal/assertion matched.
outcome_taxonomy.expected_red: A command whose purpose is to prove the fixture discriminates the pre-r14 baseline. The fixture process must exit 1 with the named baseline cases failing for the access-before-refusal reason. This is a pass of the verification and a red of the baseline tool; it must not be reported as a green tool result.
outcome_taxonomy.fail: The command ran and contradicted the contract: wrong exit code, a missing or extra finding id, a failed literal assertion, a timeout (124/137), or an unexpected traceback.
outcome_taxonomy.could_not_evaluate: The command could not reach a verdict: an artifact is absent, non-regular, symlinked or has an unpinned digest; a prerequisite (python3, shellcheck, /var/tmp) is unavailable; a fixture exits 2 for setup/environment; or the fixture executes zero cases. Record as NOT-RUN/blocked with the blocked claim; never count it as pass.
outcome_taxonomy.distinction: Fixture exit 1 on the installed arm is fail. Fixture exit 2 is could-not-evaluate. Fixture exit 1 on the baseline arm is expected_red. A baseline arm that exits 2, 126, 127 or cannot find the baseline file is could-not-evaluate, not red.

policy.no_retained_green: Do not use census/round-13/run-verification.py --retry-failed or copy any prior green. The round-13 retainer reuses a prior result without comparing measurement-time dependency digests; reusing it here would make the round-14 evidence stale by construction. Re-run every check at the final commit.
policy.measured_commit: Measure at one commit with a clean target pathspec. Capture git rev-parse HEAD before the suite and re-check it after; a changed HEAD or dirty target pathspec makes every measured_commit claim could-not-evaluate.
policy.no_live_mutation: Read-only checks only. No --keep on the demonstration, no real credential-store path, no operator-sweep directory access, no quarantine action.
forbidden: --root pointing at or above a credential store
reading, listing, hashing or copying ~/.omp/agent content
reading or writing census/operator-sweep-20261019/ or census/operator-sweep-20261018/

It therefore runs list_repos/census_one through the store on 01-04 and 06, reads the store compare file on 05, and leaves GIT_COMMON_DIR/GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY/alternates in place on 09. Cases 07-08 exercise paths the baseline already handles. If the observed red set differs, record the difference as a fixture coverage finding; do not rewrite the baseline expectation to match the run.
literal_provenance.note: The GateRegistry draft named R14C2-01, -05 and -08 as the red cases; that draft predates the landed fixture and its numbering does not match. This plan uses the landed case table.
literal_provenance.derivation: The 9 case ids, case functions, red/green expectations and TOOL/SUMMARY line formats were read from the landed fixture; the last working-tree bytes observed while finalizing were sha256 bdcbfbc0 (CensusBoundary.md pinned d712ac79 before its final edits). The installed census digest is read at run time and compared to the fixture's TOOL line; no digest in this check is trusted from prose.
literal_provenance.report_confirmation: CensusBoundary.md states the installed arm: exit 0, all nine PASS; baseline arm: exit 1, total=9 failed=7, R14C2-01..06 and R14C2-09 FAIL, R14C2-07/08 PASS. These are pre-run targets, not exercised results.

checks.failure_class: Installed arm exit 1/FAIL/canary/stderr = fail; installed exit 2 = could-not-evaluate. Baseline arm exit 0 or 2, a missing red case, a failed positive control, or a missing access/wrong-exit detail = fail (the fixture did not discriminate).

sequence: C-R14V-00 preflight: clean target pathspec, captured MEASURED_COMMIT, artifact digests.
C-R14V-08 C1 external fixture installed arm and missing-tool refusal.
C-R14V-09 C2 boundary fixture installed green, then baseline red.
C-R14V-07 sources census and S038 locator.
Recompute the C-R14V-00 digest map and HEAD; any change is could-not-evaluate, not pass.

postamble.shell: set -e; /usr/bin/sha256sum "$R/tools/souji-evidence-cache.py" "$R/tools/souji-census.sh" "$R/tests/fixtures/r14-evidence-cache.py" "$R/tests/fixtures/r14-census-boundary.py" "$R/tests/fixtures/r14-cache-frozen/record.json" "$R/tests/fixtures/r14-cache-frozen/expected.json" "$R/tests/fixtures/r14-cache-frozen/dependency.txt" "$R/census/round-14/cache-demonstration.py" > "$SCRATCH/artifacts.after.sha256"; /usr/bin/cmp -s "$SCRATCH/artifacts.before.sha256" "$SCRATCH/artifacts.after.sha256"; /usr/bin/git -C "$R" rev-parse --verify HEAD | /usr/bin/grep -qx "$MEASURED_COMMIT"; test -z "$(/usr/bin/git -C "$R" status --porcelain -- tools tests census/round-14)"; for f in tools/souji-evidence-cache.py tools/souji-census.sh tests/fixtures/r14-evidence-cache.py tests/fixtures/r14-census-boundary.py census/round-14/cache-demonstration.py; do /usr/bin/git -C "$R" cat-file -e "$MEASURED_COMMIT:$f" || exit 2; /usr/bin/test "$(/usr/bin/git -C "$R" show "$MEASURED_COMMIT:$f" | /usr/bin/sha256sum | /usr/bin/cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(/usr/bin/sha256sum "$R/$f" | /usr/bin/cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 1; done

expect.why: Q6/Q18: the bytes measured are the bytes the verdict names, and the measured commit did not move during the run.
